description: Run an Agent402 tool by slug (discover slugs with catalog.find or catalog.search; params must match that tool's inputSchema). The 168 pure-CPU tools execute free on this hosted connector (rate-limited, no wallet - proof-of-work covers them) and return the tool's JSON result. Wallet-only tools (live search/answer, browser render, market data, STT, durable memory) answer with a payment ask that is payable right here over MPP (the challenges ride in _meta["org.paymentauth/payment-required"], and the text names every other way to pay) - this connector holds no wallet of its own. An unknown slug returns an error pointing back to catalog.search.

params.description: Tool input, matching the tool's inputSchema

name: catalog.call

outputSchema.description: Envelope around the invoked catalog tool's native JSON result

result.description: Native tool output (shape depends on slug)

title: Run an Agent402 tool
